acceptanceCriteria: gitauth resolves a relative per-worktree gitdir back-pointer against the directory that holds it, and still refuses a back-pointer that does not name the worktree it was read from.
A test creates a linked worktree with --relative-paths and runs a CEM read command from it successfully; a mismatched relative back-pointer is still refused.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0197 re-review. From a linked worktree created with `git worktree add --relative-paths` (gitdir back-pointer like ../../../../relwt/.git), CEM commands fail with 'per-worktree gitdir back-pointer does not resolve' (internal/cem/gitauth/repo.go:166). The same failure reproduces on origin/main d138a58, so it predates V1-0197.
title: cem: gitauth rejects linked worktrees created with git worktree add --relative-paths
